inferences.statement: The pull-request template may not consistently prompt for rollback planning.
limitations: The fixture contains only three invented pull requests.
A missing note does not show that rollback was not discussed elsewhere.
alternatives: The changes may have been considered trivially reversible.
Rollback planning may have occurred outside the pull-request description.

recommendations.action: Trial an optional rollback-or-not-applicable prompt for two weeks.
recommendations.success_measure: Compare completion and reviewer usefulness feedback during the trial.

recommendations.warning: Unsupported and unsuitable for personnel use.
